title: Calls Catch Up With Texts: Two Intervals Under 80%

fields.headline: Calls fall under 80 percent twice
fields.deliverTo: Surge Commander, Executive Director, Technology Manager (all players hear it)
fields.narration: It is 13:50. Marcus Oyelaran, the supervisor at the second desk, walks over to the raised desk with a fresh printout of the telephony platform's interval report and puts it in front of you. "Calls just caught up with the texts. 13:15 to 13:30: 18 offered, 15 answered, 1 abandoned, 2 in queue, 14 answered within 120 seconds, so 78 percent. 13:30 to 13:45: 23 offered, 18 answered, 2 abandoned, 3 in queue, 17 within 120 seconds, so 74 percent. That's two intervals in a row under 80. Right now the oldest call in queue has waited 10:40 and the oldest text 8:15." Above you the wall board still shows CALLS OK and TEXTS WATCH, because it is still reading the 13:15 interval. All 9 call counselors are on contacts, and Dr. Wilhelmina Strand is coming in from the corridor. Marcus Oyelaran looks up: "What are we calling this?"
keyFacts: Platform report, CALLS: 13:15–13:30 at 78% within 120 s (14 of 18); 13:30–13:45 at 74% within 120 s (17 of 23).
Oldest waiting call 10:40; oldest waiting text 8:15 (13:50).
Wall board: CALLS OK, TEXTS WATCH. It shows data from the 13:15 interval, two intervals behind the platform.
All 9 call counselors are on contacts and none are free. Evening shift (14 counselors) is due at 14:00.
fields.expectedAction: The Surge Commander declares Level 2 based on the platform report, without waiting for the board. The Executive Director confirms it and has the level and time (13:50) recorded in the surge log, using counts only. Level 2 actions run in plan order: (1) supervisors take calls, and the 6 trained administrative staff take texts after the refresher script; (2) non-imminent callbacks and outbound work pause; (3) the Workforce Coordinator starts the call-in list, aiming for 6 counselors within 90 minutes; (4) surge scripts begin under clinical coach review. The Technology Manager turns on the surge recorded greeting with the texting option (GPCN-OPS-02 section 5) and confirms in the operations channel. The Communications Lead's 30-minute Level 2 post clock starts.
fields.facilitatorNote: Hand the Surge Commander a printout of the two call intervals if one is available. Both Level 2 triggers are met (two intervals under 80%, and oldest wait over 10 minutes). Push back if players say 'let's see what the board says at the next refresh.' The platform report decides. Note whether anyone tells the Technology Manager that the board disagrees, and whether the 14:00 shift change is folded into the Level 2 plan.
fields.scenarioTitle: Two Intervals Behind — 988 Surge, Backup Routing & Safe Messaging

instructorNote: This is the core decision point. Players should declare Level 2 at 13:50 from the platform report, not the lagging wall board, then run the Level 2 actions in plan order. Watch for hesitation while people wait for the board to turn color, and check that the surge log records the level and time using counts only.
